expo.name: SmartPlant Sarawak
expo.description: Identify and map endangered plants in Sarawak using AI-powered plant identification

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to take photos of plants for identification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app accesses your photo library to select plant images for identification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app uses location services to map plant sightings.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SmartPlant Sarawak to access your camera to take photos of plants for identification.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SmartPlant Sarawak to access your photos to select plant images for identification.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SmartPlant Sarawak to use your location to map plant sightings.
